title: Call Snapshot Lens — axioms and wireframe sketches
body:
Summary:

This note captures design axioms and early low-fidelity wireframe descriptions for a new 'Call Snapshot Lens' in Console. The goal: give engineers a single, scannable view that summarizes an individual failed or slow inference call (timeout, 5xx, model error), plus contextual telemetry and quick triage actions. This is intended as a complement to the session/trace timeline — not a replacement.

Design goals / axioms (short):
- Single-pane decisive view: one screen to decide whether the call is customer-impacting and what to do next.
- Signal-first: highlight the small set of signals that explain most incidents (latency percentiles, error code, token counts, KV cache hits, model variant).
- Actionable primitives: every diagnostic card should have 1–2 immediate actions (replay, reroute, add to watchlist, annotate).
- Lightweight provenance: show enough linked artifacts (logs, traces, prompt snapshot, model version) to reproduce the problem without deep navigation.
- Keyboard-first triage: support quick hotkeys for analysts to mark, annotate, or escalate.
- Poor-man’s RCA scoring: show probabilistic root-cause suggestions (e.g., network jitter vs model OOM) based on heuristics/scoring rules.

Target users and scenarios:
- Oncall SREs responding to a spike of timeouts; need to confirm whether a specific call is symptomatic.
- ML infra engineers chasing model OOMs/quantization regressions.
- Product engineers investigating customer-reported hallucination/regression.

Information hierarchy (what to surface, top -> bottom):
1) Header summary line: single sentence with outcome and one-line cause guess.
   - Example: "POST /v1/generate 2024-07-18T08:23Z — 504 timeout (KV cache miss; model variant: gptx-13b-q4)"
2) Quick metrics row (compact chips): status code, latency (actual), p50/p95 for route, token_in/token_out, kv-cache-hit, model-variant, region.
3) Mini timeline (sparkline) for the call life: socket connect -> request send -> first-byte -> last-byte or error. Hover shows timestamps.
4) Error details card (collapsible): raw error payload, model stack message (if any), kernel OOM flags, upstream 5xx body.
5) Deterministic signals list: system load, GPU mem, model quantized flag, request size, prompt shape (presence of streaming function calls), recent config rollouts.
6) Heuristic RCA panel (one-line scores): network, model, runtime, routing, upstream. Each score is clickable to expand evidence.
7) Repro snapshot: exact request body (anonymized), truncated tokens, applicable replay route button (sandbox replay), and link to request in audit log.
8) Actions row: replay-in-sandbox, add-to-watchlist, create-incident (pre-populated), attach to eval suite, ignore/mark-noise.
9) Provenance footer: linked traces, log snippets (3 lines max), related incidents, contributors.

Wireframe notes (desktop):
- Top bar: Title + small outcome badge (green/yellow/red), timestamp, small dropdown for customer context (if call tied to account).
- Left column (40% width): key metrics and mini timeline + sparkline + diagnostic chips stacked. Use compact numerical typography for p50/p95.
- Center column (40%): Error details card (expanded by default for failing calls), followed by Repro snapshot. Prominent replay button near repro snapshot.
- Right column (20%): Heuristic RCA panel (vertical list of causes with score bars), quick actions, and a small 'similar calls' list (calls with identical model+route in last 5 mins).
- Inline affordances: when hovering evidence in RCA, highlight matching line(s) in the log snippet area.

Mobile / narrow-width constraints:
- Collapse into stacked blocks: header -> metrics -> timeline -> error -> actions -> evidence. Actions should be condensed into a single 'Actions' dropdown to avoid clutter.

Interaction flows (small walkthroughs):
1) Oncall path: open Call Snapshot from incident, glance header + chips, confirm 504 + KV cache miss. Click 'replay in sandbox' -> modal pre-fills request with anonymized prompt -> run -> if repro, click 'create-incident' to attach sandbox logs.
2) ML infra path: spot model OOM indicator in error details -> expand model memory chart (linked) -> click 'related calls' to see other OOMs -> add model-variant to watchlist (creates rollout alert).
3) Product QA path: open call via customer ticket -> repro snapshot shows long prompt with trailing function calls -> add prompt to failing-prompts eval set with single click.

Heuristic RCA rules (initial set):
- Network: RTT spike between client and gateway > 2x median in last 5 mins AND socket connect time > threshold.
- Model: model error codes containing OOM/overflow, or runtime memory > 90%.
- Routing: fallback to slow model variant OR request routed cross-region.
- Size: token_in > 2x typical for the route OR embedded binary payload.
- Quota: per-customer rate-limit throttles present.
Each rule outputs a short evidence snippet and a confidence score (0–100).

Minimal telemetry to include (for each call):
- start_time, end_time, outcome_code, latency_ms, p50_route, p95_route, token_in, token_out, kv_cache_hit (bool), model_variant, region, worker_id, gpu_mem_free_at_start, runtime_version, kernel_logs_id. Keep raw logs links short.

Sketch annotations (visual cues):
- Outcome badge color: red = hard failure (5xx/timeout), amber = degraded (p95 > target), green = ok.
- Evidence highlight color: teal for network, purple for model, orange for runtime.
- Small iconography: tiny GPU icon next to model-variant, clock for latency, document for repro snapshot.

Backlog / grooming items (ordered by priority):
1) (P0) Basic Call Snapshot API + backend support — return telemetry payload for a single call. Accepts call_id and returns metrics + truncated logs. (Est: 5 dev-days)
2) (P0) Front-end scaffold: three-column layout + chips + error card + actions. Include keyboard shortcut 'G' to open a focused Call Snapshot modal. (Est: 6 dev-days)
3) (P1) Heuristic RCA prototype service — runs set of rules server-side and returns scores. Start with three rules (network, model-oom, token-size). (Est: 4 dev-days)
4) (P1) Sandbox replay integration — lightweight containerized replay with sanitized prompt and replay results stored under call_id. (Est: 8 dev-days)
5) (P2) Similar calls grouping UI and filters (time window + model variant). (Est: 3 dev-days)
6) (P2) Mobile responsive layout adjustments + dropdown actions. (Est: 2 dev-days)
7) (P3) Keyboard-driven triage mode + quick macros (mark+assign). (Est: 4 dev-days)
8) (P3) Acceptance tests & e2e replay flow automation. (Est: 5 dev-days)

Acceptance criteria (for MVP):
- Console can render Call Snapshot for a call_id in <500ms (client-render time).
- Header + metrics + timeline + error card + replay button visible without extra clicks for failing calls.
- Backend returns sanitized request body with PII removed.
- Heuristic RCA returns at least 3 cause scores for failing calls.

Open questions / risks:
- Privacy: how aggressive should automatic sanitization be? Need legal guidance for customer prompt retention. (Action: loop in security/compliance)
- Replay fidelity: sandbox replay must match production model environment to be useful — do we use a cached variant or spin a dedicated ephemeral worker? Cost implications.
- RCA false positives: heuristic-based scoring risks finger-pointing; need to surface confidence clearly and allow analysts to override.

Notes for follow-ups / next steps:
- Sync with infra: ensure telemetry keys we need are instrumented in serving runtime (gpu_mem_free_at_start, worker_id, runtime_version). (Owner: Ravi)
- Prototype frontend: produce 3 quick mock screens (dark/light) and iterate in next design review. (Owner: Claire)
- Legal checkpoint: write short policy for prompt retention in sandbox/replay. (Owner: Aisha)

Appendix: quick sketch text (for designers/devs to translate into Figma)
- Screen A: Focus mode modal (centered) — header row with route + badge, chips row, wide timeline, expandable error details taking most of modal, action bar at bottom.
- Screen B: Pane mode (in right rail) — small version of snapshot with abbreviated chips and direct 'open full' button.
- Screen C: Incident group view — list of related calls with inline RCA scores; clicking a row opens full snapshot.

Small UX heuristics:
- Default collapsed vs expanded: for non-failing calls keep error card collapsed; for failing calls expand.
- Limit logs shown to 3 lines with direct 'open in logs' link. Avoid infinite scroll and nav loops.
- Make 'replay' explicitly destructive-safe (copy of request only, sandboxed).

If this layout and set of features sounds reasonable, I'll produce quick Figma wireframes (3 states) and a narrower engineering API spec for the backend payload shape.

Quick links referenced in discussion:
- Jira: JIRA-CR-2317 (Call telemetry enhancement)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482 (prototype components)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-UI-CallLens-Overview

Notes-to-self: keep this doc intentionally conversational — this is a coordination artifact for next grooming.
